String.string:
[EN] Maximum HP increased by 20%.
[ES] HP máximo aumentado un 20%.

[EN] Power increased by 10%.
[ES] Poder aumentado un 10%.

[EN] The combat area is closing.
[ES] La zona de combate se está cerrando.

[EN] Destroy the Manacache and choose among three paths.
[ES] Destruye el Manacache y elige entre tres caminos.

[EN] You have selected the Path of the Unknown.
[ES] Has seleccionado el Camino de lo Desconocido.

[EN] You have selected the Cliff Passage of Koleogg.
[ES] Has seleccionado el Pasaje del Acantilado de Koleogg.

[EN] You selected the Force Platform.
[ES] Has seleccionado la Plataforma de Fuerza.

[EN] Acidity
[ES] Acidez

[EN] It is diffficult to breathe due to the high acidity of the area.
[ES] Es difícil respirar debido a la alta acidez del área.

[EN] Can’t dodge Vesporax’s attack.
[ES] No puedes esquivar el ataque de Vesporax.

[EN] Skyreach Flower removes toxin from each party member.
[ES] Skyreach Flower elimina la toxina de cada miembro del grupo.

[EN] Defeat every Oddritu in 15 seconds.
[ES] Derrota a cada Oddritu en 15 segundos.

[EN] Failed to destroy all the Oddritus. Yativio delivers a wide-area attack.
[ES] No se pudieron destruir todos los Oddritus. Yativio lanza un ataque de área amplia.

[EN] Skyreach Flower has appeared. Each party member will be cured if you destroy it.
[ES] Ha aparecido Skyreach Flower. Cada miembro del grupo será curado si la destruyes.

[EN] Lightning will strike the Lightning Induction Device for 40 seconds.
[ES] Caerán rayos sobre el Lightning Induction Device durante 40 segundos.

[EN] Berserk Tuberelle appeared! Berserk Tuberelle’s self-destruct damages Yativio, too!
[ES] ¡Apareció Berserk Tuberelle! ¡La autodestrucción de Berserk Tuberelle también daña a Yativio!

[EN] The Acidic Field created by Vesporax can be removed with an Alkaline Water Bomb.
[ES] El campo ácido creado por Vesporax se puede eliminar con una Alkaline Water Bomb.

[EN] Left-click to throw the Alkaline Water Bomb to remove the Acidic Field.
[ES] Haz clic izquierdo para lanzar la Alkaline Water Bomb y eliminar el campo ácido.

[EN] Lightning strikes periodically. Being struck while covered in crystal dust will cause a burn.
[ES] Los rayos caen periódicamente. Ser alcanzado mientras estás cubierto de polvo de Crystal causará una quemadura.

[EN] Jump to shake off dust.
[ES] Salta para sacudirte el polvo.

[EN] Yativio’s toxin is strong. 10 stacks of Toxin will result in death.
[ES] La toxina de Yativio es fuerte. 10 acumulaciones de Toxin resultarán en la muerte.

[EN] Grace of Resurrection is granted.
[ES] Se otorga Grace of Resurrection.

[EN] Increases Crit Factor by 10%.
[ES] Aumenta el índice de golpe crítico en un 10%.

[EN] Decreases cooldown for all skills by 5%.
[ES] Reduce el tiempo de reutilización de todas las habilidades en un 5%.

[EN] The door opens.
[ES] La puerta se abre.
